name: animated-button
title: Animated Button
description: Buttons with hover, press and loading animations.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. The Primary colour option takes the theme's primary colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the chosen palette.

props.name: variant
props.label: Hover effect
props.description: What happens on hover: a dot that fills, letters that stagger or scramble, a drawn underline, or a drawn border.

props.name: surface
props.label: Background
props.description: Filled or outlined background. Not used by Link; with Border draw both look the same.

props.name: tone
props.label: Colour
props.description: Colour of the button: the theme's primary, a status colour, or a gradient.

props.name: rollingText
props.label: Rolling text
props.description: The label rolls up to a copy of itself on hover. Not used by Char stagger or Scramble.

props.name: shimmerText
props.label: Shimmer text
props.description: A light sweeps across the label. Not used by Char stagger or Scramble.

props.name: pressFeedback
props.label: Press feedback
props.description: The button presses in slightly when clicked.

props.name: magnetic
props.label: Magnetic
props.description: The button leans towards the mouse as it gets close. Off on touch screens.

props.name: showLoadingState
props.label: Show loading state
props.description: Clicking shows a loading spinner, then a check, then resets.

props.name: icon
props.label: Icon
props.description: Icon shown beside the label, or none.

props.name: iconPosition
props.label: Icon position
props.description: Puts the icon before or after the label. Needs an icon.

props.name: rounded
props.label: Roundness
props.description: Corner radius of the button. Not used by Link.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long the hover effect takes, in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.label: Stagger
props.description: Gap between each letter's move, in seconds. Needs the Char stagger effect.
